concepts.title: Lowball
concepts.idea: A lower, wider, friendly lowball glass silhouette, WIDTH noticeably greater than its height. Cobalt tile. Pale ice-blue solid tumbler with gently tapered sides, broad almost-flat rounded base and a shallow asymmetric wave top. Two circular cobalt bubble holes inside, small lower-left and medium upper-right. A modest orange bubble floats above the right rim, half the relative size of the orange bubble in the reference. Firm, substantial and calm, with more open space around the floating bubble.

concepts.title: Clear glass
concepts.idea: A glass defined by a THICK COBALT OUTLINE on a PALE ICE BLUE tile. Tallish gently tapered vessel, straight horizontal rim, softly rounded bottom corners. Orange liquid fills the lower half with a broad shallow wave surface, separated from the outline by a thin but robust pale gap. Two pale circular bubble holes in the orange liquid and one small orange circular bubble in the clear upper half. No floating circle outside this glass. A clearly contained fizzy drink, sculpted clear negative space. Outline weight about 10% of glass width.

concepts.title: Tall fizz
concepts.idea: A tall clean ORANGE highball-glass solid silhouette on a DEEP NAVY tile, approximately twice as tall as wide, slight taper, flat lower base with small corner radii and shallow curved top. Three bold pale ice-blue circular bubbles rise diagonally within it, growing upward; one final small pale bubble escapes just above the rim. Maximum contrast and a lively vertical rhythm. No glass outline, no extra wave stripes, no additional floating orange bubble. Distinctly elongated compared with reference.

concepts.title: Orange wave
concepts.idea: An ORANGE app tile with a generous, very simple COBALT tapered tumbler centered inside it. The glass upper half is PALE ICE BLUE with one broad gently rolling cobalt liquid wave occupying the lower two thirds, all contained in one glass silhouette. Two pale circular holes rise inside the cobalt liquid and one small COBALT bubble floats over the upper-right lip. Compact glass, broad shoulders, more angular bottom with slight corner softness. Graphic three-color shape, warm and cheerful, no outline or glass reflections.

REMOVE the horizontal plinth/foot from the reference completely: the left upright ends in a simple round-ended vertical stroke. Outer arch a smooth semicircle; keep the left stem taller than the short right outlet. Generous negative space. Slightly lighter weight and softer than reference.

concepts.title: Continuous pour
concepts.idea: A smooth pale ice-blue gooseneck faucet on a DEEP NAVY tile. The left stem rises from a small understated flat base into a compact curved arch, ending at a short downward outlet. An ORANGE vertical pill-shaped stream hangs just beneath the outlet, separated by a small clear gap, reaching down to the same baseline as the faucet stem. A single small pale circular bubble cuts into the lower part of this orange stream. The flowing orange stroke replaces the reference's round drop entirely. No glass, no splash.

concepts.title: Faucet + glass
concepts.idea: Combine the two loved motifs in one simple compact mark: pale ice-blue gooseneck faucet at left curves over a small ORANGE tapered tumbler at lower right. Cobalt tile. Faucet has no foot/plinth and moderate stroke weight. One small orange circular drop bridges outlet and glass; glass has a shallow wave lip and exactly one cobalt bubble hole. Keep glass and faucet visually separate with generous cobalt air. Two clearly readable silhouettes, only one bubble and one drop, no extra details, no handles, no countertop.
